CanonicalStatement: Store Slug is unique across the platform and never duplicated.
DispositionRationale: Directly enforced in Domain and SQL unique index

CanonicalStatement: Every product customer cart order and inventory record belongs to a single specific store.
EvidenceStatus: Partially Implemented (Catalog & StoreSettings Passed; Cart/Orders Planned)
DispositionRationale: Maps one-to-many across PR-01 OR-01 REL-01 and future Cart/Customer invariants

CanonicalStatement: A merchant cannot access or modify another store's data.
EnforcementLayers: API Authorization Policy;Application Scope;Persistence Composite FK
VerifiedPersistenceOrCodePath: No Merchant write/auth path at baseline (Public read isolation enforced by StoreDirectoryResolver & StoreId query predicates)
DispositionRationale: Enforced on public catalog reads; merchant membership policy pending Gate 2/3

CanonicalStatement: Products are visible to customers only when Published (and in an active Category).
DispositionRationale: Catalog Slice hardening explicitly clarified that Category.IsActive also gates public visibility

CanonicalStatement: Customer cannot order a quantity exceeding Available inventory.
EvidenceStatus: Partially Implemented (SQL invariants Passed; Checkout reservation Planned)
DispositionRationale: Shares IN-01..IN-03 invariants across Inventory and Checkout

CanonicalStatement: Server recalculates all product prices delivery fees and order totals.
VerifiedPersistenceOrCodePath: Product.Create enforces StoreSettings currency & MoneyPrecision (PublicCatalog read only; Checkout not implemented)
DispositionRationale: Linked with MNY-01 (Currency & StoreSettings) and OR-03

CanonicalStatement: Order line items retain purchase-time snapshot of product name and unit price.
Cancellation is prohibited once the order reaches a disallowing state.
DispositionRationale: Exact customer cancellation cutoff state requires Product Owner approval

CanonicalStatement: Reserved inventory for an order is released at most once.
DispositionRationale: Enforces idempotent release across IN-04 and OR-08

CanonicalStatement: Pickup is available only for a Physical store when PickupEnabled is true.
DispositionRationale: Enforced in StoreSettings domain factory and mutator

CanonicalStatement: Internal fulfillment address must never be exposed as a public store visit address.
